methodology.metric_basis: The source groups dividend yield, P/E, P/B, EPS growth and ROE under Consensus Forward Estimates.
methodology.forecast_horizon: The exact forecast year or rolling horizon is not specified in the supplied headings.
methodology.price_basis: Source snapshot prices are retained only as evidence. They are not adjusted across corporate actions and must not produce historical price returns.
methodology.reference_values: Fair value and target price remain undifferentiated where the underlying provider and concept have not been resolved per row. Neither is a market price.
methodology.dates: Report dates and price observation dates are separate. Intraday availability times are not supplied.
methodology.range_basis: Minima and maxima describe only the supplied observations, not a continuous historical valuation range or trading signal.
methodology.use: Descriptive comparison only; no historical strategy test or consensus-surprise series is established.
